findings.title: XSS via <style> tag bypass - CTF Flag
findings.description: Stored/Reflected XSS vulnerability via the 'name' parameter on /page. The application blacklists HTML tags using regex r'<(?!style\b)[^>]+>' which allows <style> tags. Adding onload='alert("XSS")' to the <style> tag triggers JavaScript execution in the headless browser, bypassing the filter.

reproduction.expected: Page returns success message with flag
